description: This file defines the API and data structures for managing sets of object identifiers (OID arrays). It includes functions for appending, searching, sorting, filtering, and iterating over object ID arrays. The file emphasizes efficiency and is used for handling large lists of object identifiers in an optimized manner.

methods.name: oid_array_append
methods.description: Adds an object ID to the array, possibly resizing internal storage and updating internal state.

methods.name: oid_array_lookup
methods.description: Performs a binary search for an object ID within the array; sorts the array if it is not already sorted.

methods.name: oid_array_clear
methods.description: Frees internal memory of the array and resets it to an empty state.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each
methods.description: Iterates over each object ID in the array, executing a callback function, stopping if the callback returns non-zero.

methods.name: oid_array_for_each_unique
methods.description: Iterates over each unique object ID in the sorted array, executing a callback function.

methods.name: oid_array_filter
methods.description: Retains only entries for which the provided callback returns true, maintaining order.

methods.name: oid_array_sort
methods.description: Sorts the array of object IDs in ascending order.

methods.name: size_t oid_array_next_unique(struct oid_array * array,size_t cur)
methods.description: Returns the index of the next unique object ID after the given position, assuming the array is sorted.

ctags.name: oid_array_next_unique
ctags.pattern: /^static inline size_t oid_array_next_unique(struct oid_array *array, size_t cur)$/
